newsitem.title: USA: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.
newsitem.headline: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.

text.p: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls as of 0810 CDT.
LIVE CATTLE - Steady to up 0.200 cent. Strong boxed beef and fed cattle markets, but slow ahead of Cattle-on-Feed.
FEEDER CATTLE - Steady to up 0.200 cent. Index up and corn seen easier.
LEAN HOGS - Steady to up 0.200 cent. Higher cash hog markets on strong packer interest.
PORK BELLIES - Steady to up 0.300 cent. Out-of-town report considered bullish and cash market firm.
